key_insight: Pathology foundation models enabled training-free retrieval of similar salivary gland tumor cases, with Atlas2 achieving the highest reported Top-1/3/5 retrieval performance.
clinical_relevance: Retrieving archived cases and their diagnostic codes could support case-based differential diagnosis of rare tumors, though this study did not evaluate clinical diagnostic benefit or drug discovery.
method: Query a digitized archive with a manually or automatically selected whole-slide image region.
Retrieve morphologically similar cases, ICD-O codes, and corresponding slides without task-specific retrieval training.
Compare Atlas2, Atlas2-B, Atlas2-S, and UNI2h using leave-one-case-out evaluation.
evidence_signal: Among 137 cases across 12 ICD-O categories, Atlas2 achieved 62.5%, 76.7%, and 81.3% Top-1/3/5 retrieval; macro-F1 was assessed only for the five classes with at least 10 cases.
watch_item: The small, imbalanced dataset limits generalizability; broader external validation is needed before routine diagnostic use.
paper_title: Pathology foundation models for training-free case retrieval in salivary gland tumors
